name: Douro Valley (N222)
description: Along the Douro between Peso da Régua and Pinhão through terraced port vineyards, often called the world's best driving road

name: Estrada Nacional 2
description: Portugal's 'Route 66' from Chaves in the north to Faro, through the interior's small towns and hills

name: Serra da Estrela
description: Up to Torre, mainland Portugal's highest point at 1,993 m, through glacial valleys from Covilhã to Seia

name: Sintra Mountains
description: Forest roads past Pena Palace and the Moorish castle, out to Cabo da Roca, mainland Europe's westernmost point

name: Arrábida
description: A coastal ridge road above turquoise coves between Setúbal and Sesimbra

name: Costa Vicentina
wiki: Southwest Alentejo and Vicentine Coast Natural Park
description: The wild Atlantic coast from Vila Nova de Milfontes to Sagres and Cape St. Vincent

name: Peneda-Gerês
description: Portugal's only national park: granite mountains, reservoirs, waterfalls and stone villages in the far north

name: Alto Douro wine region
description: Quintas and viewpoints such as São Leonardo de Galafura above the river's bends

name: Monsanto and the historic villages
description: Granite hill villages near the Spanish border, Monsanto's houses wedged between boulders
